verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents its own automated bank reconciliation workflows for linked bank accounts, which covers the transaction-matching core of the story. Nothing shows an agent running a month-end close end-to-end. The API exposes journal entries and reports, but these are only developer building blocks: there is no reconciliation or bank-transaction endpoint and no exception-flagging or close-review workflow. Missing for 10: agent-driven or API-exposed reconciliation, exception flagging, month-end close preparation and human-review handoff, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: FreshBooks lets you link your bank account and create automated workflows for bank reconciliation and transaction management
